deficits.suggestion: Add a pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the intersection to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when crossing a wide road.
Install dropped kerbs at the marked pedestrian crossing to improve accessibility for wheelchair users and those with mobility aids.
Install street lighting along the road to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers, especially during low-light conditions.

ratings.reason: The road is wide with a marked crossing but no central refuge island is visible.
The resolution and angle of the frames do not clearly show whether kerb ramps are present or missing.
Street lighting poles are clearly visible on both sides of the road.
